notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're happy to announce the release of patch 1.1 for The Captives: Plot of the Demiurge.
This patch includes a variety of quality of life improvements, as well as bugfixes.
Below you can read a list of all the changes we've made to the game.

Quality of life changes:
[list]
[*]	Added the ability to restart a dungeon, this allows you to change your build as well.
[*]	Improved UI scaling on 4k monitors, as well as low-resolution screens.
[*] 	Upgraded the Unity Version to 2018.2.12.
		This should resolve the issue that some users reported, that caused the game to only show a black screen on launch.
[*]	Added the option to skip the credits.
[*]	Improved the victory screen at the end of the game.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]	Fixed various typos.
[*] 	Fixed a potential error in the credits.
[*] 	Fixed a wrong title for the level of the savegame upon completing the game.
[*] 	Fixed various issues that caused inconsistent lighting.
[*]	Fixed kill achievement stats not updating properly.
[*]	Fixed issues with exotic keybinds.
[*]	Fixed first tutorial in the level 1 intro showing, even though the no-tutorial modifier was enabled.
[*]	Fixed npcs being able to be pushed around in dungeon 5.
[*]	Minions now die upon defeating the boss in dungeon 6.
[*] 	Fixed lag spike upon entering boss fight in dungeon 8.
[*]	Fixed a bug where loading a completed savegame was no longer possible.
[/list]
	
Changes to levels:
[list]
[*] 	Fixed a floating chandelier in dungeon 1.
[*]	Fixed an incorrect texture in dungeon 2.
[*]	Fixed a wrongly configured light in dungeon 3.
[*]	Fixed a position of an enemy in dungeon 4 that caused issues in "Dante Mode"
[*] 	Fixed an issue with a decal in the hub.
[*]	Fixed a wrongly configured light in dungeon 5.
[*] 	Fixed a z-fighting issue in dungeon 5.
[*]	Moved a key in dungeon 7 slightly.
[*]	Increased rotation speed of the boss in dungeon 8.
[*] 	Fixed an invisible wall in hub outro 8.
[*]	Fixed guard escaping prison in the intro to level 9.
[*] 	Fixed potential navigation issues in dungeon 9.
[*] 	Fixed a floating bag in dungeon 10.
[/list]
